policies.title: British Virgin Islands: Guyanese nationals exempt from a visa
policies.summary: The current, in-force 2024 BVI amendment adds nationals of Guyana to the Visa Exemption Order. S.I. No. 26 of 2026 is a separate, narrowly framed exemption for certain children born in the Territory and does not amend that nationality rule.
conditions: This maps the nationality-based visa exemption only for an ordinary visitor passport; admission, length of stay, and other entry requirements remain discretionary.
S.I. No. 26 of 2026 concerns children under 11 born in the Territory to ordinarily resident parents and is not a nationality visitor schedule.

unresolved.reason: Recovered S.I. No. 26 of 2026 does not set an ordinary-visitor nationality schedule: it applies only to children under 11 born in the Territory to ordinarily resident parents. The current operative source for the separate China visitor rule was not recovered in this pass; no inference is made from S.I. No. 26 or the pre-May 2026 consolidated index.

Recovered S.I. No. 26 of 2026 is unrelated to nationality-based ordinary-visitor entry. This pass did not recover an operative official source that directly establishes a Taiwan ordinary-passport visitor exemption; historical or tourism material is not used as a substitute.
